title: [finding] `check:cross-package-test-inputs` answers 1 or 0 depending on whether `packages/spec` has been BUILT — the author who follows AGENTS.md is the only one who sees the red, and CI never does
body:
⛔ **Filed bare and ungraded** by the `domain:spec` execution seat, session `session_01KB5PFtxuy1x3dcR5gxudx6`, 2026-09-16T10:5xZ. `domain:*`, type and priority are triage's. ⛔ Not claimed, ⛔ not dispatched.

Dedupe keywords: `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `packages/spec/dist`, `gitignored build output`, `build-state-dependent gate verdict`, `init-created-files-summary.e2e.test.ts`.

## ⭐ Two independent rounds reproduced this separately, in different worktrees, on different cards

This is not one agent's reading repeated. Two `os-dev` rounds that shared no worktree and no card — #18203 (`packages/lint`) and #18113 (`packages/spec`) — each hit the same red on the same day, each isolated it to the same single variable by ablation, and each reported it as out of scope for its own card. Neither round's diff contains either of the paths the gate names.

## The defect

`pnpm check:cross-package-test-inputs` exits **1 on a tree that has merely been BUILT**. It descends the real filesystem (`readdirSync`), and `packages/spec/dist/` is a gitignored build output that no declared glob reaches inside. Its complaint names `packages/cli/test/init-created-files-summary.e2e.test.ts` descending into `packages/spec/dist/`.

Isolated to ONE variable, measured twice independently:

| tree state | exit |
|:--|--:|
| diff + `packages/spec/dist/` present | **1** |
| diff + `dist/` moved aside | **0** |
| no diff, no `dist/` (shared checkout) | **0** |

The #18113 round ablated it in a single tree with identical sources (115 `dist/` entries parked and restored). A pristine `origin/main` worktree also exits 0 — **because nothing there is built**, ⛔ not because the blind spot is absent.

## ⚠️ Why this is worse than a noisy gate

The lint job does not build `spec`, while `AGENTS.md` **requires** building `spec` before pushing. ⇒ the author who follows the repo's own rules is the only person who ever sees this red, and it reads to them as *"your change broke something"* — while CI, which never builds, reports green.

That is the "red on main while every PR reports green" direction, pointed at the gate itself; the gate's own header exists to prevent exactly it.

## Not repaired in either round

Both rounds declined to fix it in place, with the same reason: it is a gate, not a file a feature PR passes through, so it has no natural inheritor. ⇒ it needs its own card or it will be re-discovered by the next agent who builds before running gates — which is now twice in one day.

## Provenance

- #18113 round report (comment `5696158346`) — 115-entry `dist/` ablation in one tree, identical sources.
